sents.t: I asked him why, and he said, “I started feeling like I had to live up to in private the things that I was saying in public.”
sents.zh: 我问他为什么，他说：“我开始觉得，私下里我也得做到自己在公开场合说的那些事。”
gloss: 踮起脚够到那条标准线。
关上门，没人看见的时候。
站在大家都看得见的地方。

sents.t: Right.
sents.zh: 对。

sents.t: It’s what Emerson said, “Foolish consistency is the hobgoblin of little minds.”
sents.zh: 就像爱默生说的：“愚蠢的一致性，是心胸狭窄者的心魔。”
gloss: 每天放一块砖，一直不断。
藏在角落里捣乱的小妖怪。

sents.t: But essentially, look, all learning is error correction.
sents.zh: 但本质上，你看，所有的学习都是纠错。
gloss: 发现写错的地方，划掉改对。

sents.t: Every knowledge creation system works through making guesses and correcting errors.
sents.zh: 每一个创造知识的系统，都是靠猜测和纠正错误来运作的。

sents.t: So by definition, if you’re learning, you’re going to be wrong most of the time and you’ll be updating your priors.
sents.zh: 所以按定义来说，只要你在学习，你大部分时候都会是错的，你会不断更新自己原有的看法。
gloss: 字典上写的意思就决定了。
看到新证据之前，心里已有的判断。

sents.t: For example, I did this Joe Rogan podcast, I don’t know, eight or nine years ago, and people will call out like the one thing that didn’t turn out to be correct.
sents.zh: 比如，我大概八九年前上过 Joe Rogan 的播客，人们会揪出那唯一一件后来证明不对的事。
gloss: 大声把别人的错指出来。

sents.t: They just beat on it because it helps them in their mind raise their status a little bit – “I caught him in an error.”
sents.zh: 他们就揪着不放，因为在他们心里这能让自己的地位提高一点——“我抓到他犯错了。”

sents.t: If you catch someone in a blatant lie where they believe one thing and say another, that’s legit – that’s a character flaw.
sents.zh: 如果你抓到某人公然撒谎，心里信一套、嘴上说一套，那批评是合理的——那是人品缺陷。
gloss: 性格这块拼图上的一道裂缝。

sents.t: They shouldn’t be lying.
sents.zh: 他们不该撒谎。

sents.t: But on the other hand, if they just made a guess at something and they got it wrong.
sents.zh: 但另一方面，如果他们只是对某件事做了猜测，结果猜错了。
gloss: 一只手放一边，另一只手放另一边。

sents.t: Mostly it’s about the AI AGI thing, and I think I’m still right about that, but it’s a different story.
sents.zh: 主要是关于 AI、AGI 那件事，我觉得我在这点上还是对的，不过那是另一回事了。

sents.t: People who think we have achieved AGI just fail a Turing test from their side.
sents.zh: 那些认为我们已经实现了 AGI 的人，只是从他们那一边没通过图灵测试。
gloss: 隔着屏幕，分不出是人还是机器。

sents.t: It’s funny how people latch onto single proclamations, but the reality is all of us are dynamical systems.
sents.zh: 有意思的是，人们会死抓住某一句表态不放，但现实是，我们每个人都是不断变化的动态系统。
gloss: 像钩子一样挂住就不松。
一直在流动、变化的整体。

sents.t: We’re always changing, always learning, always growing, and hopefully we’re correcting errors.
sents.zh: 我们一直在变、一直在学、一直在成长，希望也一直在纠正错误。

sents.t: But what you don’t want to be doing is lying in public because you’re trying to look good.
sents.zh: 但你不该做的，是为了让自己显得好而在公开场合撒谎。

sents.t: I think people can smell that.
sents.zh: 我觉得人们闻得出来。
gloss: 鼻子一闻就知道不对劲。

sents.t: What this world really lacks right now is authenticity, because everybody wants something.
sents.zh: 现在这个世界真正缺少的是真诚，因为每个人都想要点什么。

sents.t: They want to be seen as something, they want to be something that they’re not.
sents.zh: 他们想被看作某种人，想成为自己本来不是的样子。
gloss: 别人眼里给你贴的标签。

sents.t: So you catch a lot of people saying things that they don’t really believe, and I think people are very sensitive to that.
sents.zh: 所以你会发现很多人说着自己并不真信的话，我觉得大家对此非常敏感。
gloss: 一点点变化都能感觉到。

sents.t: Bullshit radars have become hypersensitized to try and work out whether or not this person means the thing that they’re saying.
sents.zh: 人们的“废话雷达”已经变得超级敏感，想要判断这个人是不是真心说这些话。
gloss: 远远就能探测到的感应器。

sents.t: Most of us are wrong most of the time, especially in any new endeavor.
sents.zh: 我们大多数人大部分时候都是错的，尤其是在做任何新尝试的时候。

sents.t: There’s a difference between being wrong and disingenuous though.
sents.zh: 不过，犯错和不真诚是两回事。

sents.t: Purposefully wrong.
sents.zh: 故意说错。

sents.t: Correct.
sents.zh: 没错。

sents.t: Exactly.
sents.zh: 正是。

sents.t: I think that’s the big difference.
sents.zh: 我觉得这就是最大的区别。

sents.t: If someone is wrong, no big deal, as long as they have a genuine reason for saying what they’re saying or believing what they’re believing.
sents.zh: 如果有人错了，没什么大不了的，只要他们说这些话、信这些事有真实的理由。
gloss: 嘴上说一套，心里想的是另一套。

sents.t: But if they are lying to elevate their status or their appearance or to live up to some expectation, that’s the mistake.
sents.zh: 但如果他们撒谎是为了抬高自己的地位、形象，或者为了符合某种期待，那就错了。

sents.t: And that’s a mistake not just for the listener, it's a mistake for themselves, because then you’re going to get trapped in a hall of mirrors.
sents.zh: 而且这不只是对听的人来说是错误，对他们自己也是，因为那样你就会被困在一个镜子迷宫里。
gloss: 镜子迷宫（真假难辨的处境）
四面都是镜子，找不到真自己。

sents.t: You yourself are going to be consistent with your past proclamations, so if you’re lying to others, you’re going to be lying to yourself.
sents.zh: 你自己会努力和过去的表态保持一致，所以如果你对别人撒谎，你也会对自己撒谎。

sents.t: You’re puppeted by a person that you are not even.
sents.zh: 你被一个你根本都不是的人操控着。
gloss: 身上绑着线，别人一拉就动。

sents.t: That’s right.
sents.zh: 没错。

sents.t: It’s like, what was the line?
sents.zh: 就像，那句话是怎么说的来着？

sents.t: You’re basically trying to impress people who don’t care about you.
sents.zh: 你基本上是在努力讨好那些根本不在乎你的人。

sents.t: And they don’t like the real you, and if they saw the real you, they wouldn’t care.
sents.zh: 他们并不喜欢真实的你，就算看到了真实的你，他们也不会在乎。

sents.t: And the people who would like the real you don’t get to see the real you, so they pass you by.
sents.zh: 而那些会喜欢真实的你的人，却看不到真实的你，于是就和你擦肩而过。

sents.t: You only want the respect of the very, very few people that you respect.
sents.zh: 你只需要得到极少数你尊重的人的尊重。

sents.t: Trying to demand respect from the masses is a fool’s errand.
sents.zh: 想让大众都尊重你，是白费力气。
gloss: 跑了一趟注定白跑的腿。
